candidates.change_summary: Change return value from true to false.
Delete require statement so empty _tos array is allowed, changing the return value from revert to true.
Replace the require statement with a no-op so the function can continue for empty _tos arrays.
Replace the transferFrom selector hash string with the non-existent 'transfer(address,uint256)' so the encoded call uses the wrong selector.
Change the loop initialization to start at i=1 so the first recipient is skipped.
Change the loop condition to allow an out-of-bounds index when _tos is non-empty.
Swap the caller-supplied from address with the current contract address in the external call arguments.
Return false instead of true after all calls complete.
Remove the require statement so that empty _tos arrays are allowed, changing behavior when _tos.length is 0.
Change the signature hash to a different function selector, altering the low-level call’s effect.
Change the return value from true to false, altering the observable boolean result.
Delete the for loop body, making the external calls never happen.
Change the call target from caddress to this, altering where the external call is sent.
Delete the guard requiring _tos.length > 0, so empty _tos arrays no longer revert.
Change the transferFrom selector hash preimage so calls use a different function selector.
Initialize the loop counter to 1, so the first recipient is skipped.
Change the loop condition to i <= _tos.length, causing an out-of-bounds access and revert.
Replace the loop increment with i += 2, so only every other recipient is processed.
Swap the argument order in the external call so the recipient address is passed as the from argument.
Return false instead of true after processing the transfers.
